AUTHOR: Li
TITLE: Multi-species identification and number counting of fish passing through fishway at hydropower stations with LigTraNet
REGION: Fishway of Y Hydropower Station, Tibet, China
SPECIES: Schizothorax oconnori, Racoma waltoni, Schizothorax macropogon, Schizopygopsis younghusbandi, plus generic 'Fish' for tiny fish
DATA: Own fishway video, 2022 passage season (Mar-Aug); 5374 annotated key frames; 3 MOT16-format test videos; counting on random footage 15 May-15 Jun
V_EV: Sec 4.5: 'The deviation observed between the fishway monitoring method and manual counting results was primarily attributed to image blurring in high-turbidity scenarios'
D_EV: Sec 2.1: 'This dataset was then divided into training and validation sets in an 8:2 ratio using a random selection process.'
R_EV: Sec 2.1: data 'collected from the actual fishway of the Y Hydropower Station in Tibet, China, with data collected during the 2022 fish passage season'
C_EV: Sec 2.4: 'detection thresholds of IoU = 0.3 and score = 0.3'; Table 6 reports IDSW; counting by line crossing of DeepSORT tracks.
E_EV: Sec 2.2: 'The baseline data for calculating counting accuracy were derived from manual observations. Two researchers... observed the fishway videos and recorded the type and number of fish.'
ARCH: LigObNet (YOLOv8n with C1 module, DWConv, SimAM) + DeepSORT (LigTraNet), line-crossing counter
METR: Precision, recall, mAP, Params, GFLOPs, FPS, memory; IDF1, IDSW, MOTA, MOTP; counting accuracy vs manual count
NOTE: Detection evaluated on random 80/20 image split of key frames (no separate test set mentioned). Tracking/counting evaluated on 3 videos and random footage 15 May-15 Jun 2022 (same season as training data; overlap with training frames not stated). C5 coded because IDSW is measured and counting uses a line-crossing rule on tracks; verifier may consider this tracker-choice only. Sec 4.4 claims deployment at three hydropower stations with >90% accuracy after manual review but no data/station details -> R1=N. Score threshold 0.3 stated without sensitivity analysis.
